7164329cf13c6354.description: Company Description Abdullah Ibrahim Al Sayegh and Sons Company, established in 1964 as a Closed Joint Stock Company, is one of the leading water and wastewater infrastructure contractors in Saudi Arabia. With over 60 years of experience, the company delivers major construction and operation and maintenance projects, including water and wastewater networks, transmission pipelines, treatment plants, tunneling, reservoirs, dams, buildings, and roads. Al Sayegh has a proven track record of collaboration with leading government and private entities, including NWC, SWA, NEOM, Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC), RCRC, and other major organizations. Supported by a workforce of over 3,000 engineers, professionals, and technical staff, the company is committed to quality, environmental responsibility, and supporting Saudi Vision 2030. Role Description The Quality Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and ensuring quality standards across infrastructure construction projects, including potable water, wastewater, stormwater drainage, irrigation, and firefighting networks, as well as earthworks and civil works associated with electrical, street lighting, ICT, and chilled water networks. Daily responsibilities include conducting quality inspections and tests, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, monitoring construction activities, identifying non-conformities, and coordinating corrective actions with project teams. The Quality Engineer will ensure compliance with approved quality procedures, project specifications, and client requirements, while maintaining quality documentation and coordinating with consultants and site teams to ensure successful project delivery. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Minimum of 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) Previous experience in infrastructure construction projects, particularly utility networks and related civil works Strong knowledge of quality control procedures, inspection methods, and construction quality standards Ability to review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) Experience in conducting site inspections, monitoring material testing, and managing Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills Saudi nationality is required

71ad20efa4bb261f.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities. About LIONS Riyadh LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry. Job Description The Head of Marketing, will report into the Marketing Director and will manage a diverse team based in Riyadh. The Head of Marketing will lead the brand, audience and go-to-market strategy for LIONS Riyadh, establishing the Festival as one of the most important new creative industry platforms in the region and a recognised part of the global LIONS community. The individual will be a highly motivated, dynamic marketing leader with a track record of commercial collaboration to develop products and positioning reflective of customer demand. This role requires a distinctive combination of brand thinking, creative judgement, audience insight and commercial marketing expertise. The successful candidate will understand how to build desire around a premium global brand while making it culturally relevant to Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. Managing a diverse team of managers, marketing executives and specialist functions the Head of Marketing will be a skilled marketing strategist and be able to drive creativity and enthusiasm in others. The individual needs to be analytical and data orientated with a history of testing and optimisation, but with creative flair and exceptional attention to detail. They will be responsible for creating a marketing platform that feels unmistakably LIONS – bold, intelligent, culturally connected and creatively distinctive – while delivering measurable audience, revenue and brand-growth objectives. The candidate should have extensive experience of digital marketing, content marketing and marketing technology and be accustomed to delivering in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The role will work closely with LIONS, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial and Partnerships to ensure every campaign strengthens the Festival's positioning, builds community and attracts the highest-value regional and international audiences. The individual must be extremely adaptable, accustomed to working with differing market dynamics and be able to guide marketers and steer campaign strategy accordingly. Key Performance Indicators Working alongside commercial leads to develop value propositions and go-to-market strategy Ongoing customer insight and engagement strategies Overseeing delivery of marketing campaigns in line with business objectives Adherence to timelines and budgets Marketing KPI report To manage a cross functional marketing team which includes marketers from all backgrounds with a diverse range of skills and training To design and deliver campaigns for specific projects as and where required Building strong awareness, consideration and demand for LIONS Riyadh across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and priority international markets Growing the Festival’s reputation as a leading regional platform for creativity, marketing, media and culture Driving qualified registrations, ticket sales and attendance from priority audience segments Increasing engagement with senior CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, creators and emerging talent Ensuring all campaigns reflect the LIONS brand, tone and creative standards Maximising the impact of speaker, content and partner announcements across paid, owned and earned channels Delivering strong digital engagement, conversion and return on marketing investment Building an active year-round community around the LIONS Riyadh brand via content marketing Driving effective collaboration across Marketing, Content, PR, Commercial, Creative and LIONS teams To act as a change management ambassador, demonstrating a positive and constructive attitude towards challenges and change Key Responsibilities LEADERSHIP Recommend team structures and delivery solutions based on requirements Line manage senior marketers and specialists working across a range of events Work with Group Director to ensure right structure, specialisms and level of resources to meet agreed KPI’s Provide guidance, feedback and inspiration to line reports Build a high-performing, creatively ambitious marketing team capable of delivering to LIONS brand standards. Champion bold thinking, strong creative judgement and audience-first marketing across the team. Champion the adoption and optimisation of marketing technology solutions and digital marketing more broadly Work with line reports to ensure successful delivery of marketing campaigns in line with agreed KPI’s, event and divisional strategy Work with line reports to develop skills and competencies and ensure they have a clear development roadmap Ensure line reports are competent managers and have the skills and training required to manage junior team members or specialists Ensure adoption and optimisation of marketing technology solutions, identify training needs and ensure line reports are technically proficient Create strong collaboration across Marketing, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial and the LIONS team. Reflect the high-performance culture of the marketing team. ANALYSIS & INSIGHT Monitor campaign performance by supervising the production of relevant and timely reports. Recommend changes to campaign execution based on data insights Share relevant insights with sales, event team and senior management to drive revenues or pursue new opportunities Analyse and report trends over time and use these insights to build more effective campaigns Ensure relevant and timely data is captured (onsite & post show surveys, registration forms, industry research etc) Work with internal teams to ensure data governance and data management policies are adhered to Ensure delivery and accuracy of pre-agreed reports during and post campaign to monitor channel effectiveness and ROI Use recommended campaign analytics dashboards to

71b967c70a825dd0.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced Machinery Outfitting Engineer (Procurement Support) to join our team. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will provide essential engineering support for machinery procurement activities, ensuring that all procured equipment aligns with project requirements, technical specifications, and applicable marine standards. Key Responsibilities Provide engineering and technical support for machinery outfitting procurement in marine, shipbuilding, and offshore vessel projects. Review project specifications, equipment lists, machinery arrangements, and procurement requirements to identify suitable equipment and suppliers. Prepare and review technical requisitions, equipment specifications, datasheets, and other procurement-related engineering documents. Review vendor quotations, technical proposals, and compliance statements for alignment with project specifications. Perform technical bid evaluations (TBEs) and prepare technical comparison sheets for machinery and equipment procurement. Coordinate with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, equipment manufacturers, and suppliers to clarify technical requirements and resolve queries. Review vendor drawings, equipment layouts, installation requirements, foundation details, and interface information for compliance. Verify machinery dimensions, weights, power requirements, utility connections, operating conditions, and maintenance clearances against project requirements. Ensure compatibility of procured machinery with vessel layouts, machinery spaces, foundations, piping systems, electrical interfaces, and other outfitting disciplines. Support the preparation and review of purchase requisitions, material requisitions, and technical documentation for procurement packages. Respond to technical queries from vendors and procurement teams, coordinating with relevant engineering disciplines to resolve discrepancies. Monitor vendor document submissions and coordinate technical reviews for timely approval and compliance with project schedules. Support technical clarification meetings with suppliers and participate in vendor evaluations as required. Review vendor deviations, proposed alternatives, and technical exceptions, coordinating with the engineering team for assessment and approval. Ensure compliance with applicable marine classification requirements, project specifications, international standards, and client requirements. Maintain procurement engineering records, technical bid evaluation documents, vendor data, and equipment documentation. Support inspection, testing, and equipment delivery coordination by ensuring technical and documentation requirements are fulfilled. Coordinate with construction, production, and installation teams to address procurement-related technical issues and ensure equipment suitability. Ensure procurement engineering deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of hands-on experience supporting procurement of marine machinery, mechanical equipment, and associated outfitting components. Strong experience in reviewing technical specifications, equipment datasheets, vendor quotations, and supplier documentation. Experience conducting technical bid evaluations (TBEs), preparing technical comparison sheets, and reviewing supplier compliance. Good understanding of marine machinery systems, equipment arrangements, machinery foundations, installation requirements, and multidisciplinary interfaces. Experience coordinating with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, equipment manufacturers, and suppliers to resolve technical queries. Familiarity with marine classification society requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, and project specifications. Understanding of machinery interfaces with piping, HVAC, electrical, instrumentation, and hull structure disciplines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience maintaining technical procurement documentation and vendor data registers. Preferred Attributes Experience with marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments. Required Skills Strong technical evaluation and analytical skills. Excellent documentation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and procurement environment. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

71d78b616adbbd6e.description: Eram Talent, a leading talent acquisition company, is seeking an experienced Horticultural Training Officer. In addition, the position will contribute to knowledge sharing, staff development, and educational initiatives that support the Botanic Gardens conservation, research, and visitor engagement objectives. Scope of Work Develop, coordinate, and deliver comprehensive horticulture training programmes for staff and volunteers. Assess horticulture training needs and identify skills gaps across garden operations. Develop structured training plans aligned with operational requirements, horticulture standards, and organisational objectives. Deliver theoretical and practical training covering relevant horticulture practices, techniques, and procedures. Develop training materials, manuals, guidelines, presentations, practical demonstrations, and other educational resources covering horticulture best practices. Ensure training materials remain technically accurate, relevant, accessible, and aligned with current horticultural standards. Develop appropriate competency assessments and methods for evaluating the effectiveness of training programmes. Maintain records of staff participation, training completion, competency development, and certification where applicable. 714a7f3a5fdddfbd.description: About the Role Alesayi Holding is seeking a Fleet Supervisor to manage regional fleet operations in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the transportation of the workforce between accommodation and client sites, utilizing buses, vans, and service vehicles. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in fleet management. Role Overview The Fleet Supervisor is responsible for ensuring reliable and efficient transportation services by managing fleet costs, vehicle utilization, maintenance, safety, and regulatory compliance. The role also includes driver workforce management and monitoring operational performance across the regional fleet. Key Responsibilities Manage the regional fleet budget, including fuel, maintenance, leasing/ownership, drivers, and fines; monitor cost per kilometre and per vehicle, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions. Review and approve supplier invoices and statements of account for fuel, maintenance, leasing, insurance, and spare parts; reconcile charges, investigate discrepancies, and dispute unjustified costs. Develop and review regional route plans, consolidate trips, and optimize fleet size based on operational demand; utilize GPS tracking and fleet data to minimize idle vehicles and unauthorized use. Ensure adherence to preventive maintenance schedules and validate vehicle inspections, registration, insurance, permits, and roadworthiness requirements; monitor vehicle availability and minimize downtime. Enforce driver operating procedures and road-safety standards; investigate incidents, ensure compliance with driving licence requirements, rest hours, and vehicle checks, and follow up on corrective actions. Plan driver staffing levels according to operational demand; manage driver rosters, shifts, attendance, leave coverage, performance, and conduct through Fleet Operations Coordinators. Coordinate transportation requirements for new project mobilization, demobilization, and changes in workforce demand to ensure timely availability of vehicles and drivers. Prepare and review monthly regional fleet performance reports covering trips, kilometres, fuel consumption, vehicle utilization, availability, incidents, and cost per kilometre; identify improvement opportunities. Supervise Fleet Operations Coordinators and drivers, establish performance expectations, address operational issues, and ensure effective coordination across shifts and project locations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in fleet supervision or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage regional fleet operations, including budget, maintenance, and compliance. Experience with driver workforce management and operational reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring active management of regional fleet operations and coordination with various teams and project sites. Application Process Candidates interested in this Fleet Supervisor position are encouraged to apply.

71a44d8d929c4dcf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سيارتك للتسويق الالكتروني عن مدير مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير المبيعات مسؤولية الإشراف على أنشطة المبيعات للسلع والخدمات، وضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة للشركة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة واسعة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الأهداف الرئيسية والخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية لأنشطة المبيعات، وضمان تطبيقها بنجاح والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف المباشر على كافة الأعمال والأنشطة اليومية للمبيعات، بما في ذلك ضبط أسعار البيع ومراقبة حركة المبيعات ومستوياتها لمختلف المنتجات والخدمات مقارنة بالخطط والتوقعات المالية. ضمان التنسيق والتواصل الفعال مع شركاء العمل، وبناء قاعدة واسعة من العملاء والتواصل المستمر معهم للتعرف على ملاحظاتهم حول أساليب البيع والأسعار والعروض المنافسة. تقديم التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة العليا بناءً على ملاحظات العملاء ودراسات السوق. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد التقارير والتحليلات الفنية لأنشطة المبيعات السابقة، ومراجعتها وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع المقترحات والتوصيات الفنية المستندة إلى هذه التحليلات. الإشراف على أداء موظفي المبيعات وتوجيههم نحو أفضل أساليب وممارسات البيع، وضمان فهمهم لمواصفات وخصائص المنتجات والخدمات. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق المبيعات، وضمان توافر جميع الموارد والمواد والتقنيات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال وأنشطة البيع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو إدارة المبيعات. فهم عميق لأساليب وأماكن البيع ودراسة السوق. القدرة على إعداد تقارير المبيعات وتحليل مستوياتها. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة سيارتك للتسويق الالكتروني. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

71ba817c596319cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مستشفي الدكتور سليمان عبدالقادر فقيه عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من تقييم الحالة الصحية وحتى توثيق الإجراءات الطبية، مع الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض، وجمع وتحليل البيانات من المريض وذويه، وتحديد احتياجات الرعاية التمريضية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية، ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإبلاغ الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عمليات الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي بدقة واحترافية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير الممارسات التمريضية يتوقع من أخصائي التمريض في هذا الدور المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة للمرضى. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييمها. مهارات ممتازة في أخذ العلامات الحيوية والعينات المخبرية وإعطاء الأدوية. القدرة على توثيق الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية بدقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في شركة مستشفي الدكتور سليمان عبدالقادر فقيه بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، حيث يتم التركيز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا الملتزم بتقديم رعاية صحية متميزة.

7168827f5116ec78.description: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Fleet Supervisor to oversee daily fleet operations and ensure maximum vehicle availability, safety, compliance, and cost efficiency. The ideal candidate will have experience managing transportation fleets, vehicle maintenance, driver performance, and operational reporting within a fast-paced logistics or supply chain environment. Responsibilities Supervise daily fleet operations to ensure maximum vehicle availability and operational efficiency. Manage vehicle allocation and driver assignments based on business and delivery requirements. Monitor fleet utilization and identify opportunities to improve productivity and reduce downtime. Coordinate preventive and corrective vehicle maintenance activities with workshops and service providers. Ensure all vehicles maintain valid registrations, insurance, inspections, and regulatory documentation. Track fuel consumption, maintenance expenses, and other fleet-related costs while supporting cost optimization initiatives. Monitor vehicle condition and ensure all safety standards and company policies are consistently followed. Investigate vehicle accidents, damages, traffic violations, and operational incidents, and implement corrective actions when required. Supervise driver performance, attendance, compliance, and adherence to safety procedures. Support driver onboarding, training, and performance improvement programs. Coordinate with Operations, Warehouse, Procurement, Finance, and external vendors to ensure smooth fleet operations. Prepare and maintain accurate fleet records, reports, and operational documentation. Generate regular fleet performance reports and KPIs for management review. Identify process improvement opportunities and implement solutions to enhance efficiency, service levels, and fleet performance. Support fleet expansion, optimization, and continuous improvement projects. Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Transportation, or a related field. 3–5 years of experience in Fleet Operations, Transportation, Logistics, or Supply Chain. Minimum 2 years of supervisory experience. Experience managing commercial vehicles, vans, trucks, or distribution fleets. Strong knowledge of fleet management and transportation operations. Experience in vehicle maintenance management and compliance. Knowledge of cost control, route planning, and vendor management. Strong reporting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools. Strong communication and team coordination skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment.

7175674d049ca60e.description: About the Role Moyasar is seeking a Fraud Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. As a financial company operating in the payments sector, fraud prevention is critical for protecting customers, payment services, and business operations. This full-time role involves monitoring transactions and user activity, investigating suspicious cases, and supporting effective fraud detection and prevention within the company's payment and wallet environment. Key Responsibilities Monitor transactions, accounts, and user activity to identify potential fraudulent behavior. Review and investigate fraud alerts and suspicious transactions. Analyze transactional and non-transactional data to identify unusual patterns, trends, and fraud indicators. Investigate suspected fraud cases and document findings clearly. Assess and authorize high-risk payment transactions in line with established fraud controls and procedures. Raise and manage chargeback claims on behalf of customers and follow up on cases through resolution. Support the identification and prevention of emerging fraud typologies. Escalate high-risk or complex cases to appropriate stakeholders. Maintain accurate records of fraud investigations, decisions, chargebacks, and actions taken. Work with relevant teams to improve fraud detection rules, monitoring processes, and controls. Analyze fraud trends and prepare reports and insights for management. Support continuous improvement of fraud prevention and detection processes. Collaborate with Risk, Operations, AML, Compliance, and other relevant teams as required. Qualifications and Experience 1-3 years of experience in fraud, fraud operations, fraud analysis, financial crime, or a related field. Hands-on experience in fraud detection, monitoring, investigation, transaction analysis, or a similar area. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Required Skills Strong attention to detail and ability to make well-supported decisions based on available data. Good communication and documentation skills. Work Environment The role requires willingness to work rotating shifts in a 24/7 operational environment, including day and night shifts, to ensure continuous fraud prevention coverage. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this position in Riyadh, Riyadh.

717dc61143d9577c.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة عمر مطلق محبوب السلمي للمقاولات عن مشرف إنشاء طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أعمال إنشاء الطرق وضمان سير العمليات بفعالية وكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر والمتابعة المستمرة على جميع الأعمال المخصصة للمشروع. مراقبة أداء العمالة والتأكد من التزامهم بالمهام الموكلة إليهم. متابعة استخدام المعدات المخصصة للمشروع وضمان كفاءتها. التأكد من أن كل مراقب مسؤول عن المنطقة المحددة له وعن المهام التي يحددها مهندس الموقع. المؤهلات والمتطلبات حاصل على دبلوم من أحد المعاهد الهندسية المتخصصة. التخصص في أحد المجالات التالية: مدني، معماري، أو كهرباء. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع إنشاء الطرق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

71977738b58292bb.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Planning Engineer to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience and involves developing, monitoring, and reporting on project schedules and progress for EPC projects. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update detailed EPC project schedules using Primavera P6. Prepare and manage baseline schedules, recovery schedules, and look-ahead plans. Monitor project progress against approved schedules and highlight deviations. Perform critical path analysis and recommend corrective actions to mitigate delays. Forecast project completion dates and support project management in schedule decision-making. Progress Monitoring and Reporting Monitor engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for management and client submissions. Develop project dashboards, progress measurement systems, S-curves, and resource histograms. Track productivity, resource utilization, and key project performance indicators (KPIs). Maintain project planning records and reporting documentation. Procurement and Manufacturing Coordination Monitor material procurement, manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and site delivery milestones. Forecast material requirements and coordinate manufacturing clearances in line with project schedules. Track vendor and subcontractor deliverables against contractual milestones. Support timely mobilization of suppliers and subcontractors. Project Controls and Commercial Support Prepare cost summaries and mobilization estimates based on received quotations. Develop techno-commercial reports to monitor project financial performance and overall project health. Assist in cash flow forecasting, cost-to-complete monitoring, and project performance analysis. Support change management, delay analysis, and Extension of Time (EOT) evaluations when required. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, QA/QC, HSE, and commercial teams for schedule updates. Participate in progress review meetings with SEC, National Grid, subcontractors, and project stakeholders. Support project management in identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

7109a7e4a50f045b.description: About the Opportunity Jacobs (KSA) is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the construction supervision of Hyperscale Data Center and Mission-Critical Infrastructure projects across all regions of Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for overseeing mechanical construction activities, ensuring compliance with critical design requirements and redundancy standards. This position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field, capable of coordinating various disciplines and verifying work quality. Key Responsibilities Supervise mechanical construction activities throughout project execution. Review contractor shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Monitor the installation and testing of chilled water systems, cooling plants, HVAC systems, CRAH units, CRAC units, fuel systems, plumbing services, fire protection systems, and associated infrastructure. Ensure compliance with mission-critical design requirements and redundancy standards. Coordinate mechanical works with electrical, ICT, structural, architectural, and commissioning disciplines. Support testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, and handover activities. Inspect completed works and verify compliance with approved specifications and quality standards. Participate in project meetings and technical reviews. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably within construction supervision for data centers or critical infrastructure projects. Demonstrated ability to oversee complex mechanical system installations and commissioning. Strong understanding of mission-critical design requirements and redundancy standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, with project responsibilities extending across various regions in Saudi Arabia. The role involves working on site to supervise construction activities and coordinate with multidisciplinary teams. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

71a5eba3515b6d00.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بدائع البردي للأدوات المدرسية عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من الجهات المختلفة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المالية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالمبالغ المستحقة من الجهات المعنية والعمل على تحصيلها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المحددة. المتابعة والتنسيق المستمر مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ النقدية، وتقديم الردود على استفساراتهم وأسئلتهم المتعلقة بالتحصيل. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات بشكل دوري ومستمر، مع الالتزام التام بتعليمات سرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. الالتزام الكامل بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لعمليات تحصيل المبالغ المستحقة والتقيد بها بدقة. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق ذات الصلة، وترتيبها وأرشفتها بما يتوافق مع السياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التحصيل أو ما يعادله. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات المالية بدقة وحرفية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الجهات المختلفة. القدرة على تنظيم العمل وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. الالتزام بالسرية المهنية في التعامل مع المعلومات المالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة بدائع البردي للأدوات المدرسية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال التحصيل.

71e29b0251db1c4c.description: About Mace Mace is a global consultancy and construction company that integrates expertise to deliver projects. The company's values guide its approach to consulting and define the individuals it seeks to join its teams. The Project and Role This full-time role is for a Senior Logistics Manager based in Riyadh. The successful candidate will join a Mace team working on a major entertainment and luxury hospitality project. This project involves extensive infrastructure and built assets, delivered through a hands-on construction management approach, and requires collaboration with renowned architects and global consultants. The role is suited for professionals with over 10 years of experience in managing main and sub-contract packages. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive logistics plans for land and marine transportation. Coordinate multimodal transport for heavy equipment, bulk materials, and specialized items. Optimise routes and schedules to minimize delays and costs. Liaise with procurement teams to align material delivery schedules with project milestones. Ensure compliance with international shipping regulations and customs clearance for imported goods. Manage marine logistics, including barge operations, port handling, and offshore deliveries. Oversee coordination with port authorities and shipping agents for timely vessel turnaround. Plan and manage site access, storage areas, and internal movement of materials and equipment. Implement safety and security protocols for logistics operations. Work closely with PMC teams, contractors, and suppliers to ensure seamless communication. Attend progress meetings and provide logistics status updates. Develop contingency plans for disruptions such as transport delays or supplier issues. Monitor and mitigate risks related to logistics and the supply chain. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations. Maintain accurate records of shipments, inventory, and delivery schedules. Qualifications and Experience Extensive experience (10+ years) in construction logistics, including land and marine transport. Proven experience in PMC projects or working with project management consultants. Strong knowledge of international shipping regulations, customs clearance, and port operations. Proficiency in logistics software and tools (*, ERP, RFID tracking). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, civil engineering, or a related field is desirable but not essential for candidates with relevant experience. 71e5a622ef42b7cf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صيدلية آرمين للأدوية عن مدير صيدلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في القطيف، بالمنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيكون مدير الصيدلة مسؤولاً عن الإشراف على العمليات الصيدلانية وضمان تقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تنظيم الخدمات الصيدلانية وضمان حصول المرضى على الأدوية المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم العلاجية والوقائية، بما يتماشى مع المعايير الدولية. متابعة الأداء العام للكادر الصيدلاني والإشراف على الخطط التشغيلية، وتقديم تقارير دورية بنتائج الأداء وفق نظام إدارة الأداء المعتمد. الإشراف على تخطيط وتطوير ممارسة مهنة الصيدلة، ووضع الأنظمة والمعايير والضوابط والسياسات التي تحكمها، مع ضمان توافقها مع الأهداف الاستراتيجية لوزارة الصحة وأفضل الممارسات العالمية. الإشراف على إصدار اللوائح والأوامر والنظم والدلائل الإرشادية الخاصة بالصيدلة، واقتراح السياسة الدوائية، وتحديث وتوحيد جميع السياسات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالصيدليات. إعداد ورفع تقارير دورية كمية ونوعية حول مدى استهلاك المرافق الصحية للأدوية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة أو إدارة الصيدليات. القدرة على الإشراف وتوجيه الفرق الصيدلانية. فهم عميق للمعايير الدولية والمحلية المتعلقة بالممارسات الصيدلانية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم التقارير. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنظيم. القدرة على تطوير السياسات والإجراءات وتطبيقها. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير الصيدلة في بيئة صيدلانية ديناميكية في صيدلية آرمين للأدوية بالقطيف، المنطقة الشرقية. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التزاماً بتقديم أعلى مستويات الرعاية الصيدلانية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

712c302b88603804.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية متابعة تطبيق لوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية، وإجراء التحقيقات في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية والخاصة، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية المختلفة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. موقع العمل ونوعه تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى معايير السلامة في جميع مشاريع الشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

7159e117ee39719e.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a General Cashier & Paymaster to join their team in Riyadh. This contract position is open exclusively to Saudi nationals and requires 0-1 years of experience. The role involves managing financial records, ensuring accuracy in transactions, and maintaining compliance with established policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Verify figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash, and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and maintain financial records using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Audit cashier banks periodically according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Maintain, distribute, and record petty cash, cashier banks, and contracts. Document, maintain, communicate, and act upon all Cash Variances according to SOPs. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

71a380cb9405d37f.description: About Arctech Arctech is seeking an Equipment Technician to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the reliable operation of production equipment. Role Overview The Equipment Technician will be responsible for the inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial production equipment. This role requires a strong mechanical aptitude and basic electrical troubleshooting skills to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Perform daily inspection, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting of production equipment to ensure smooth and reliable operation. Diagnose and repair mechanical faults, including pneumatic and hydraulic systems, bearings, guide rails, drive systems, and equipment structures. Troubleshoot basic electrical issues, including sensors, limit switches, contactors, frequency inverter alarms, and motor wiring. Maintain accurate maintenance and repair records and recommend improvements for recurring equipment failures. Perform spare parts replacement and support spare parts inventory monitoring. Respond quickly to equipment breakdowns, identify root causes, and restore production with minimum downtime. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in industrial equipment maintenance, with a total experience range of 5-10 years. Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills with the ability to work independently. Basic electrical troubleshooting skills and ability to read simple electrical diagrams are preferred. Ability to use basic electrical testing tools, such as a multimeter. Strong sense of responsibility and ability to handle emergency maintenance and breakdowns in a production environment. Electrician, welding, or special equipment operation certificates are preferred. 7179d58b9c7ccd2a.description: Lead enterprise-wide architecture engagements and ensure strong alignment between organizational strategy, business capabilities, digital transformation initiatives, information, applications, technology, security, and investment priorities. The Senior Enterprise Architect will define current-state and target-state architectures, guide transformation roadmaps, establish architecture governance, and provide senior-level advisory support to business and technology stakeholders. · Lead the development and evolution of Enterprise Architecture strategies, principles, standards, policies, reference architectures, and roadmaps. · Assess the current enterprise landscape and develop clear current-state, target-state, transition, and gap-analysis views across Business, Data, Application, Technology, Experience, AI, and Cybersecurity domains as applicable. · Translate organizational strategy and transformation objectives into architecture capabilities, initiatives, transition states, and investment priorities. · Develop and maintain business capability maps, value streams, enterprise-wide architecture models, dependency views, and transformation roadmaps. · Establish and operate architecture governance mechanisms, including architecture review boards, decision records, compliance reviews, and design assurance processes. · Review programs, projects, and solution proposals to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, standards, target architectures, and strategic direction. · Identify architectural gaps, duplication, technology risks, dependencies, obsolescence, and opportunities for consolidation, modernization, standardization, and reuse. · Develop and maintain architecture principles, standards, patterns, guidelines, technology standards, and reusable reference models. · Provide architecture leadership and advisory support to executives, business owners, digital transformation teams, technology functions, program managers, and vendors. · Guide and mentor solution architects and domain architects and ensure consistency across architecture deliverables. · Support portfolio planning, business cases, RFPs, vendor evaluations, technology selections, and transformation programs from an architecture perspective. · Ensure architecture deliverables are complete, traceable, understandable, and suitable for executive and technical audiences. · Facilitate architecture workshops, stakeholder interviews, design sessions, and executive presentations. · Contribute to the continuous improvement of Enterprise Architecture methods, metamodels, repositories, templates, governance practices, and quality standards. Required Experience · Typically 10–15+ years of experience in technology, architecture, consulting, digital transformation, or related disciplines. · At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Enterprise Architecture or a senior architecture leadership role. · Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale architecture assessments, target-state design, transformation roadmaps, and governance activities. · Experience working across multiple architecture domains, including Business, Data, Applications, Technology, Integration, Cloud, and Security. · Experience engaging senior executives and translating complex architecture topics into clear business-oriented recommendations. · Experience in large enterprises, government entities, regulated environments, or major transformation programs is highly desirable. Required Knowledge & Competencies · Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts, methods, governance, and operating models. · Advanced knowledge of TOGAF and practical application of architecture development methods. · Strong knowledge of ArchiMate and enterprise modeling concepts; familiarity with UML and BPMN is beneficial. · Ability to develop architecture assessments, heatmaps, capability models, transition architectures, roadmaps, principles, standards, and governance artifacts. · Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and decision-support skills. · Ability to balance strategic direction with practical implementation constraints, dependencies, and organizational readiness. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce executive-quality architecture documents and presentations. · Ability to work effectively in consulting environments and across multidisciplinary teams. Preferred Certifications · TOGAF® certification (preferred). · ArchiMate® certification (preferred). · Relevant cloud, security, data, governance, or architecture certifications are an advantage. · PMP®, ITIL®, COBIT®, SABSA®, CDMP®, or equivalent certifications are considered beneficial depending on the engagement. Preferred Tools & Platforms Experience with one or more Enterprise Architecture and modeling platforms such as Bizzdesign, Orbus/iServer, ARIS, Sparx Enterprise Architect, MEGA HOPEX, or equivalent repositories and modeling tools. Key Deliverables · Enterprise Architecture strategy and roadmap. · Current-State and Target-State Enterprise Architecture. · Architecture gap analysis and transition roadmap. · Business capability and value-stream models. · Enterprise architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures. · Architecture governance framework and review outputs. · Architecture repository and metamodel content. · Executive architecture presentations, assessments, recommendations, and decision papers. The ideal candidate can work confidently with executives and technical teams, structure complex enterprise problems, develop high-quality architecture deliverables, and provide practical guidance that connects strategy with execution.

71feed9e766b5837.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمز العمران للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي، وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الاحتياجات الهندسية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة في المشروع. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع في الموقع لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وإعداد المخططات. القدرة على إعداد جداول الكميات والمواصفات الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في الملاحظة. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الهندسية. مهارات تواصل فعالة لإعداد التقارير وعرضها. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

71024f80a1352578.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن كهربائي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في السيارات، مما يضمن الأداء الأمثل والسلامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تفسير المخططات الأولية لتركيب الأنظمة الكهربائية ومعدات السيارات بدقة. فحص الأجزاء المفردة والمجمعة جزئياً والمكتملة التجميع لضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتحديد المشكلات والأعطال المحتملة قبل تفاقمها. تنفيذ الخدمات اللازمة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في السيارات وإصلاحها، بما في ذلك أجهزة القياس، معدات الإضاءة، والمولدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال كهرباء السيارات. فهم قوي للأنظمة الكهربائية في السيارات ومكوناتها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تقع في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل كهربائي السيارات ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تقديم خدمات صيانة وتشغيل عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

714d7086c587b888.description: About Seclore Seclore is a Data Security Intelligence company focused on the era of enterprise AI. By securing data directly and ensuring its protection across all movement, Seclore aims to establish trust, control, and resilience within the modern enterprise. Seclore currently serves over 500 global enterprises and government organizations in more than 40 countries. The primary objective is to ensure these customers achieve their expected business outcomes using Seclore solutions, which contributes to customer retention, advocacy, and account growth. This position requires a strategic vision and an innovative approach to lead critical customer-facing teams, strengthen executive relationships, and drive revenue growth across the market. The Director will be instrumental in advancing customer goals, product utilization, business transformation, value realization, renewals, and expansion by ensuring the engagement, success, retention, and growth of Seclore’s customers. The role also functions as a trusted advisor and primary liaison between customers and internal Seclore teams, ensuring critical customer success needs are communicated and prioritized. Key Responsibilities Lead, expand, and mentor the Customer Success team in KSA by defining strategy, prioritizing Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and developing a world-class team. Manage a portfolio of Seclore’s largest and most strategic customers, establishing critical goals, success plans, and KPIs, and assisting customers in achieving them. Conduct discovery sessions with IT and business users to identify new use cases, business objectives, and system/application requirements. Engage regularly with assigned customers through strategic and operational discussions to assess needs, progress, risks, and strategic direction. Become proficient in each customer’s Seclore deployment and act as a trusted advisor for their strategic business direction. Present Seclore’s value proposition and product capabilities to diverse audiences, from senior executives to technical teams. Educate customers on the value derived from their Seclore solution and drive measurable value realization. Ensure customers implement best practices and that their Seclore solution is optimized for adoption, usage, security, and maximum business value. Build and maintain trusting relationships at all levels, including C-Suite, across customer teams, functional groups, business units, and group companies. Serve as the primary liaison between assigned customers and Seclore to facilitate a seamless customer experience. Ensure internal alignment on account strategy by collaborating with cross-functional Seclore teams to develop and execute account plans that foster customer references, retention, and account growth. Continuously assess customer progress toward stated goals and drive expected results across adoption, usage, business value, and the overall relationship. Advocate for customer needs, ensuring account issues are resolved promptly by leveraging internal resources. Proactively create customer-facing artifacts such as business cases, usage scenarios, solution blueprints, FAQs, and meeting notes. Support internal Customer Success and delivery teams in completing project milestones, including production go-live, UAT sign-off, and initial rollout. Gather customer product feedback and communicate with Product Management to influence roadmap development. Collaborate with the Sales team to achieve timely contract renewals and identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated passion for helping customers achieve business outcomes. Ability to multitask and assist where needed. Credibility in inspiring confidence in C-level decision-makers. Hands-on experience with endpoint security products, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification, and Digital Rights Management (DRM). Extensive business process management experience and expertise, ideally within government, banking, financial services, insurance, and manufacturing sectors. Previous experience with a major systems integrator and/or a Customer Success function is preferred. Experience with SaaS/subscription solution offerings is beneficial. 71186dcfc1569a50.description: General Summary Qiddiya City is an exciting new destination city right on the doorstep of Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The city plan will include 25 distinct masterplan districts across sports, entertainment, arts and culture, and mixed-use areas, residential communities and nature. Qiddiya City will eventually be home to more than 600,000 residents and host millions of visitors and experience seekers yearly. The Sales and Leasing Performance Unit (PLU) within Qiddiya is responsible for developing best practice sales and leasing standards and expertise within the organisation. At the heart of this unit sits the Qiddiya Real Estate LearnLab (QREL), a digital-first, gamified learning academy, designed to drive measurable commercial capability development across the Sales and Leasing function. The Senior Specialist – Training Administration role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems. This role is the operational backbone of the learning platform, aimed at ensuring that learners are correctly configured, content is accurately published and maintained, training schedules are coordinated, and learning data is surfaced in a meaningful and timely way through dashboards and reporting. About the Role/Project Scope This is a highly organised, detail-oriented, and platform management role that requires a strong working knowledge of LMS/LXP administration, digital content authoring, data and dashboard management, and learner coordination. The Senior Specialist – Training Administration will work closely with the other teams of the Qiddiya Real Estate LearnLab (QREL) to ensure the platform runs smoothly, learners receive a seamless experience, and senior stakeholders have the operational data it needs to make informed decisions. 710f35f491df2daf.description: An experienced Mechanical Engineer with a strong background in residential units HVAC and mechanical systems design reviews, material installation, site supervision, and quality inspections for the mechanical components of major building rectification and upgrade programs. This role demands a high level of expertise in the design, execution, testing, and commissioning of complex mechanical systems. The ideal candidate will ensure stringent adherence to design criteria, codes, and industry standards at every stage of the project life cycle. Key Responsibilities Perform design reviews of design packages, providing constructability insights as needed to the Design & Engineering team or consultants. Review and coordinate shop drawings, and as-built drawings across multiple trades and disciplines. Supervise and inspect mechanical work, providing day-to-day monitoring of project progress within the project scope. Perform QA/QC inspections to identify nonconforming work, issuing periodic reports to track quality metrics. Respond to contractor requests for inspections, technical queries, and site clarifications, coordinating with the project management team to issue field directives as necessary. Verify quantities and work progress to ensure accuracy in completed work calculations. Coordinate and resolve mechanical design issues that arise during construction, working closely with all stakeholders, including contractors, to ensure alignment within the project scope. Support technical decision-making on mechanical systems, providing expertise to address design or installation challenges. Assist in the installation, troubleshooting, and repair of mechanical systems as needed. Offer technical knowledge and guidance on the operation of mechanical distribution systems. Lead commissioning, startup, and adjustments of mechanical systems and components, ensuring proper function. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of experience in verifying design against construction, QA/QC, material specification, Mechanical Systems commissioning mainly residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Proficiency in engineering design tools such as SolidWorks and AutoCAD. Experience in site supervision, QA/QC inspections, and material installation. Strong experience in residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Knowledge of mechanical codes, standards, and commissioning processes. Ability to review mechanical designs and verify them against site execution. A team player with a strong aptitude for problem-solving. Ability to thrive in high-pressure environments and adapt to changing project needs. Willingness to travel to various project sites as required.
